machine.cpu: 4x Cortex-A53 (part 0xd03) @ 1.416 GHz max, NEON only (no dotprod/i8mm/fp16)
machine.governor: performance pinned on all 4 cores before certified runs

methodology.runtime: models/whisper-large-v3-turbo generic C11 runtime + targets/a113x grouped GEMM, attention and precision-preserving double-NEON stem kernels; gcc 12.2 -O3 -std=c11 -fopenmp -mcpu=cortex-a53 -mtune=cortex-a53
methodology.images: compiler/compile_whisper_turbo_image.py from the pinned F16 checkpoint (pins.json); q4/q8/q5 grouped weights (group 128, BF16 scale), biases/norms/convs F32
methodology.speed_and_rss: on-device fixed30 quantization chain plus adjacent compact JFK A/B for the stem increment; four OpenMP threads, performance governor, GNU time -v peak RSS
methodology.quality: transcript identity vs the F32 correctness baseline on jfk.wav (11 s) and the reviewer's std30.wav (27.3 s): every quantized mode must transcribe word-identically (after EnglishTextNormalizer-style normalization) to the F32 image running the same runtime on x86; device NEON output additionally checked identical to the x86 scalar output. Owner-directed scope: no 32-file battery for this small-box target
methodology.fp_note: per owner directive, no F32/FP16 runs on the device - the 3.24 GB F32 image is the sandbox-only correctness baseline
methodology.wer_platform_note: scalar x86 and NEON device paths differ only in float summation order; device transcripts spot-checked word-identical to x86 on jfk.wav and std30.wav for every mode measured

x86_cross_validation.std30_transcripts: all modes word-identical to f32 (q4 renders a cased/punctuated variant, WER-neutral after normalization)
